name: LayerWorks Solutions
summary: Small US extruder in Chattanooga, Tennessee that grew out of a print farm (owner Jonathan Holman) and says it uses US-sourced resin. It sells PLA, the lower-cost WORKS Series PLA, rPLA, high-flow PETG, PRO PCTG, ABS and FR ABS, and offers monthly OEM/bulk contracts to print farms.

product_lines.name: High Flow PETG
product_lines.notes: High-speed PETG; no high-flow PETG id exists.

additional_notes: Appears to be an original extruder; no white-label relationship found. It sells monthly OEM/bulk supply contracts to print farms, but no named client brands were found, so no manufactures-for relationship is encoded. Also sold via reach.dog/shop/layerworkssolutions. Covered by NewsChannel 9 (Chattanooga). Pricing ($15-25/kg) sits at the budget/mid boundary. Filament data is in the Open Filament Database.

provenance.conflicts: Notes rate this medium-high. HQ is Chattanooga, TN per the company site and NewsChannel 9, while a data aggregator lists Hanover, PA. US resin sourcing is a company claim. Legal form unknown.
